review: Astra Ultra paired disposable canonical-date candidate and native-test source review
scope: Fresh disposable installation only; copied main source with explicit new query ABI/compiler backend and host date validation. Not adoption into main, upgrade coverage, installed release qualification, or performance evidence.
findings: Candidate file inventory equals the copied main package inventory, excluding Python bytecode. Exactly four files differ: _query_runtime.py, _catalog_runtime/query-abi.json, query.sql and manifest.json. All other package bytes match current main.

The ABI descriptor is byte-identical to the reviewed Weft ABI 1.1 fixture and native query_abi advertises its exact SHA-256. Every manifest file digest matches its candidate payload. Retained runtime identity 0.71-candidate is a disposable development experiment, not a reusable published release identity.

Host explicitly selects weft-compile/0.2.7, IR 0.2.7, backend 0.4.41 / interface 0.2.7, and candidate compiler version 0.4.39.dev0. It still verifies original binding/model/backend/obligations, exact slot ordering, source scope, final authority, result carriers and host custody. No production default changed.

ASCII [0-9] fixed-width date regex plus date.fromisoformat admits exactly Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD with years 0001 through 9999. Original text is returned unchanged. Validation occurs for caller TextValue date parameters, compiled native date slots and decoded date results; no date/timestamp SQL cast, timezone conversion, implicit string coercion or permission caching is introduced.

Existing binary/timestamp paths, scalar decoding and absent/null envelopes are retained. The new date decoder preserves TextValue(kind=date,text=original) and leaves existing absent/null behavior intact.

The fixture uses existing public preparation, acceptance, grants, group mutation, commit and reopened consumer query paths for four original records, with 10-second statement and 30-second operation limits inherited unchanged. Literal/typed/field equality, absent/null projection and invalid-literal DATE-DOMAIN refusal are exercised. It does not claim pages, containers, complete entities, upgrade or all-schema support.
pre_execution_and_evidence_notes: Use the exact built wheel from the reviewed Weft candidate and retain its hash/source provenance plus actual installed module path/version. A matching development version string alone is not wheel provenance.
Recommended small test strengthening: assert len(joined.rows)==2 before comparing its set, so duplicate result multiplicity cannot be hidden.
fixtureCleanup=passed is written after per-test teardown; final class runtime cleanup is only established by successful terminal unittest completion. Retain terminal output and any failure.

The generator performs asserted fresh-directory creation and copies only into /private/tmp. Static inspection confirms its actual replacements landed only in the intended files. Main tracked source remains unchanged.
Parent-reported Python 3.11 compile check passed after system Python 3.9 was incompatible with existing package annotations; reviewer did not execute candidate modules or native tests.
